I can't save this for you, Ilse. I don't have a memory or note-writing tool here. I can read files but can't create or edit them, so I can't promise I'll remember Bay 30 next time.

Your message stays in our DM history. For something that sticks, add a line like "Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups: Bay 30" to your notes folder (members/ilse-varga/notes/) or your calendar. I can read it from there later.
